result.summary: The page is generally coherent, but a loading indicator and fixed bottom navigation create noticeable visual issues. Some horizontal content is clipped at the right edge, though this appears intentional for carousels.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the second restaurant card, obscuring its lower content and making the card appear cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page or ensure the last card can scroll fully above the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: A prominent loading spinner is displayed over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, which may indicate the image or card content is stuck loading.
issues.suggestion: Verify the image request and loading state, and provide a fallback image or error state if loading fails.

issues.description: The category row and fastest-restaurant carousel are visibly clipped at the right edge, showing only partial chips/cards.
issues.suggestion: If these are horizontal carousels, ensure the clipping is intentional and provide a clear scroll affordance; otherwise make the content responsive to the viewport width.
